articles.summary: The RealReal (Nasdaq: REAL), the world’s largest marketplace for authenticated luxury resale, today announced the reopening of its San Francisco flagship store in the heart of Union Square — reaffirming the company’s deep roots in the city where it was founded and its commitment to San Francisco’s downtown revival.
